digest.component_or_area: acli_graph cursor pagination and runaway guard
propositions: Three pagination loops in acli_graph.py hand-roll identical cursor-paging logic with no runaway-token guard, allowing repeated nextPageToken values to spin the loop infinitely (cabc bug class).

The shared cursor iterator must raise RunawayPaginationError when the server returns the same non-null token twice consecutively, and this error must propagate through maps' fail-open exception handlers rather than being caught and returning partial results.

Each of the three map readers in acli_graph.py must route through a single shared cursor iterator with explicit 'except RunawayPaginationError: raise' guards ahead of their existing catch-all handlers.
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages and jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain untouched with their own separate implementations and structural test suites staying green.
